## Facts and statements

- [statement] Within its firm-performance reporting scope, the GIPS handbook requires returns after transaction costs and permits estimated transaction costs only for portfolios whose actual transaction costs are not known. (low confidence) — https://www.gipsstandards.org/standards/gips-standards-for-firms/gips-standards-handbook-for-firms/
- [statement] Evidently’s cited drift documentation requires nonempty reference/current columns and filters empty or infinite values for distribution drift. It says default drift tests do not react to increasing empty counts and recommends separate null-share tests. (low confidence) — https://docs.evidentlyai.com/metrics/explainer_drift
